input.text: Every signer must present two separate identification documents before the account is opened, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves. The minimum opening deposit for a consumer checking account is $25.
sources: Every signer must present two separate identification documents before the account is opened, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
The minimum opening deposit for a consumer checking account is $25.

input.text: Retain closed account records for 7 years from the closing date.
sources: Retain closed account records for 7 years from the closing date.
Records may be destroyed only with written approval from the records custodian.

input.text: Two employees must be present to open the branch each morning. Vault combinations are changed every 6 months and whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $15 per account in a calendar year.
sources: Two employees must be present to open the branch each morning.
Vault combinations are changed every 6 months and whenever an employee who knows the combination leaves.

input.text: Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction, where appropriate. Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute, where appropriate.
sources: Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction.
Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days of receiving a completed dispute.

input.text: Fee refund requests are accepted for 60 days after the statement date. Customers may request a fee refund within 90 days of the statement date. Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year.
sources: Fee refund requests are accepted for 60 days after the statement date.
In Colorado branches, customers may request a fee refund within 90 days of the statement date.
Personal bankers may waive service fees up to $25 per account in a calendar year.
